name: jcrt
description: Journal for Cultural and Religious Theory: A Whitestone Foundation Publication

scripts.start: npm run sitemaps:generate && cross-env ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=serve NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 eleventy --serve
scripts.build:netlify: npm run nanoids:check && npm run sitemaps:generate && npm run standard:check && rm -rf _site && cross-env SKIP_IMAGE_PROCESSING=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 ELEVENTY_RUN_MODE=build eleventy --quiet && npm run sitemaps:check && npm run oai:validate:quick && npm run css:purge && npm run css:optimize && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 node _config/run-pagefind.js
scripts.css:purge: purgecss --css _site/css/bs.css --content "_site/**/*.html" --output _site/css/ --safelist show showing collapsing collapse modal-backdrop fade offcanvas-backdrop
scripts.sequoia:publish: npm run sequoia:stage && npm run sequoia:publication && npx -y sequoia-cli publish && node scripts/apply-sequoia-records.mjs && npm run atproto:frontmatter
scripts.sequoia:sync: npm run sequoia:stage && npx -y sequoia-cli sync --update-frontmatter && node scripts/apply-sequoia-records.mjs && npm run atproto:frontmatter
